title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-27
lineage: Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkII) -> Apogee MiniMe (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC/16
taper: Cassettes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton

ai_review.summary: Matrix-sourced recording praised as incredible with a high‑energy New Year’s show; Black Peter highlighted as solid.
ai_review.review: The tape, captured from Joani's MSCs (a matrix source), is described as sounding incredible and clear, with no major technical complaints. The performance is noted for its typical New Year's heat – “smokin’ hot” – and reviewers single out a strong rendition of Black Peter, while Jerry’s playing receives a brief nod. Overall the show feels lively despite limited detailed commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers are highly positive (5★) and one is moderate (3★); the zero‑star rating provides no substantive critique, so the weighted impression leans toward a strong but not flawless show/recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Taped from Joani's MSCs; reviewers note the sound is incredible and clear, with no reported dropouts or muddiness.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for bringing "the Persian love" to the performance (12/28).
